items.name: Minecraft: Java & Bedrock Edition
items.why: The reference point for worlds you can reshape, extensive survival progression and enormous modding possibilities. Keep Java mods, Bedrock add-ons and the two editions' multiplayer ecosystems distinct.
items.requirements: The PC bundle includes Java and Bedrock. Bedrock is for Windows; Java also supports macOS and Linux. Java and Bedrock are separate editions, not automatically cross-compatible multiplayer clients.

items.name: Vintage Story
items.why: The strongest match for deeper Minecraft-like survival: hands-on crafting, seasons, food preservation, metallurgy and a world built for long-term settlement. A distinct standalone game, not a Minecraft modpack.
items.requirements: Buy through a currently enabled official seller. The creator's itch.io page currently says purchasing is disabled; it is retained as an archival source, not a working purchase button.

items.name: Hytale
items.why: A block-built adventure sandbox with combat, exploration and creator tools. The current playable Early Access is distinct from older pre-release promises; follow the live update notes for feature availability.
items.requirements: Standalone Hytale launcher and a purchased game edition. Early Access is unfinished; the original announcement trailer is historical footage, not a guarantee of every advertised system.

items.name: LEGO Fortnite Odyssey
items.why: Free cooperative survival built around LEGO structures, villages, resource gathering and contraptions. A substantial playable mode within Fortnite, not a separate Steam game.
items.requirements: Requires Fortnite, an Epic account and online access. Optional cosmetics and paid passes are separate from free gameplay.

items.name: Veloren
items.why: A free open-source voxel adventure with climbing, gliding, dungeons and multiplayer. More of an exploration RPG than a Minecraft-style base-building survival simulator.
items.requirements: Use the official launcher. This is an evolving alpha; do not expect every Minecraft building or survival system.

items.name: VoxeLibre
items.why: A free Minecraft-inspired survival game with mining, farming, monsters and building, developed for the open-source Luanti engine.
items.requirements: Install Luanti, then install VoxeLibre through its game browser. Luanti is the engine; VoxeLibre is the actual game. This is not a Minecraft account or modpack.

items.name: Mineclonia
items.why: A separate community fork focused on a familiar Minecraft-style survival loop and multiplayer stability. Compare it with VoxeLibre instead of assuming their features and world formats are identical.
items.requirements: Requires the free Luanti engine. The linked GitHub project is the project's public mirror; use the upstream download directions in its README.

items.name: Terasology
items.why: An experimental open-source voxel platform with modular gameplay. Best for people interested in unusual systems and community modules, not a substitute for a finished survival campaign.
items.requirements: Gameplay depends on the selected modules and current launcher build. Development software with variable module compatibility.

items.name: Minicraft+
items.why: A compact, free top-down crafting adventure descended from the original Minicraft. A good smaller-scale alternative to committing to an enormous Terraria world.
items.requirements: Java-based community project. Use the current official release instructions; the original jam game is not counted as a separate recommendation.

items.name: Survivalcraft 2
items.why: A wilderness-focused block survival game with weather, animals, crafting and building. Check the exact platform edition instead of treating its mobile and desktop releases as one purchase.
items.requirements: Paid platform-specific editions; verify the current device requirements on the official store linked by the creator.

items.name: WILDRAFT
items.why: A small creator-hosted voxel fantasy survival discovery. The currently advertised public build is a limited demo rather than a completed large-scale game.
items.requirements: The creator describes a 30-minute demo. Treat it as an exploratory recommendation with a very small feedback base.

items.name: Path of Titans
items.why: Play the dinosaur rather than tame one. A multiplayer creature-survival alternative to ARK, with a fundamentally different progression and combat loop.
items.requirements: Official account and platform-specific access. This is not an ARK-style base-building game; check the exact edition and online requirements.

items.name: Stranded II
items.why: An influential freeware island-survival game with gathering, crafting and construction. A worthwhile historical curiosity, clearly separated from modern releases.
items.requirements: Older Windows freeware. Use the author's download; compatibility and controls reflect its age.

items.name: Cataclysm: Bright Nights
items.why: Deep, free systemic survival with crafting, vehicles and a dangerous simulated world. Turn-based and interface-heavy, not a first-person Conan substitute.
items.requirements: Separate community fork from Cataclysm: Dark Days Ahead. Follow the official release's supported-platform instructions.

items.name: LUUN
items.why: A creator-led island survival and ship-building project. Its old roadmap is not treated as proof of a finished or actively maintained release.
items.requirements: Check the creator-linked playable build and current development status before paying. An exploratory project, not an established buy recommendation.

items.name: Mine Blocks
items.why: A free creator-made 2D Minecraft-inspired browser game with mining, crafting and building. The original is now playable in HTML5; it is a fan game, not a Mojang product.
items.requirements: Play in a modern browser from the original creator. Optional Patreon support is not a required game purchase.

items.name: Mine Blocks 2
items.why: A free creator-made 2D Minecraft-inspired browser game with mining, crafting and building. This is the separate HTML5 alpha sequel, not the cancelled third project.
items.requirements: Play in a modern browser from the original creator. Optional Patreon support is not a required game purchase.

dispositions.reason: Linked as the required free engine on its games, not inflated into a separate survival recommendation.
Original and maintained community lineage explained together.
Classic creative building lacks the requested survival loop.
Old creative edition is not a separate survival recommendation.
